facts.title: Quick Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Coconut Ginger Sauce
ingredients: 1 ½ teaspoons fresh grated ginger or ¾ teaspoon powdered ginger
1 teaspoon reduced-sodium tamari or soy sauce*
½ to 2 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce or sambal oelek (to taste)**
¾ pound Brussels sprouts, nubby ends cut off, discolored leaves removed and sliced in half (smaller sprouts are better than large sprouts)
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
